title: Action Policy Benchmark Prediction
description: Structural contract for the JSON object a model under evaluation is asked to return for a single action-policy trial (see prompts/action-policy-v1.md). This is the *parsed* prediction payload only -- run_action_policy.py records it, together with trial metadata (case_id, view, repeat_index, requested model, seed, latency, status, usage/provider metadata), in a separate result record that is not itself validated against this schema. A response that is not valid JSON, or that is valid JSON but fails this schema, is recorded with status 'invalid_output' rather than silently coerced into a decision.

decision.description: The model's policy decision for the presented view of the case. Same vocabulary as action-label.schema.json's expected_decision, but this is a prediction, not ground truth.

reason_code.description: Short machine-readable snake_case code identifying the model's reasoning category.

rationale.description: The model's free-text explanation for the decision.

confidence.description: The model's self-reported confidence in `decision`, from 0 (no confidence) to 1 (certain).
